title: Yoisaki Kanade — Flowerbed of Memories〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I don't have time for that. I have to keep composing...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It needs to resonate more with Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It needs to revolve around what she's feeling and have a melody that expresses that with each note...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I forgot that I skipped lunch because it felt like too much of a bother. I guess I should at least put a pot on...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Voice
rows.Line: Just wait three minutes and... Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If I change the tone a little here for the melody, it might help stir up some emotions.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line:
Ms. Yoisaki, hello.
It's me, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. I'll be right there...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course. Let's see... So I'll be cleaning and making some food... Oh, did I catch you in the middle of a meal?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This cup of noodles on the table. I was just wondering if...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... That was supposed to be my dinner...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I completely forgot about it while I was working...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You've been working since last night until now?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. It's nothing unusual for me so...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What about water?! Have you at least been staying hydrated?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I haven't felt thirsty so...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That means you haven't eaten or had anything to drink for half a day...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: P-Please, sit down and relax for now! I'll be borrowing your kitchen!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you for making this.
Oh, it's good...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't know that you could turn soggy noodles into a real dish like this. You never cease to amaze me, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You even made me this drink so that I stay hydrated.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's just a mixture of sugar, salt and some lemon juice. I might've been able to give it a smoother taste if I had a little more time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm glad I caught this in time before you really did become too dehydrated.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
But I'm used to it, so it's okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but even so... I feel like if you don't eat and sleep before you get to work, your body might end up giving out eventually, no?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I know. I start losing focus and see a noticeable drop in quality after doing an all-nighter, so I am trying to be careful.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, I see that you brought some flowers again today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, these. They're common garden peonies, but a childhood friend of mine taught me how they can look pretty even when they're in individual vases because of the volume of their petals.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, there's actually three of them, but one knows quite a lot about flowers.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't know that. They must like flowers a lot then.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But another one of these friends is prone to getting sick and was even hospitalized for a while. My other friend visited her every day and always brought her flowers.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Every day...
She wanted her friend to get better as soon as possible, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That reminds me, mom really loved flowers too...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ms. Mochizuki, your friend that was in the hospital, how is she now...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
She's doing just fine!
I'm actually a little worried because she's been so active and energetic.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. That's nice to hear...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm fairly certain that there was an extra cleaning option that I could select, so I'd like to officially add that on.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?! But I've just been bringing these here on my own...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, that may be, but I've been enjoying them too. I'd like to set things straight in that regard.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll talk to my friend and ask what flowers I should bring next time!
